title: Plan cards in a row
description: Three cards, the middle one is outlined and marked “Popular”.

thread.answer:
- Three plan cards side by side; the middle one carries the emphasis.
- The “Popular” badge plus an outline does the selling, not a bigger price.
- Cards share one structure so the rows line up.

Sections:
- Plan header
- Price
- Feature list
- Call to action

Terms:
- Anchor plan: the highlighted middle tier.

How to apply:
- Highlight exactly one plan.
- Keep feature lists the same length across cards.
